verdict.rationale: skills.sh hosts a public Skills Leaderboard, and community members describe browsing it. The CLI documents `skills find` / keyword and interactive search, including org-wide search (`--owner`). A hands-on probe confirmed `skills add <repo> --list` lists every skill with its description without installing anything. missing for 10: an on-site explanation of the ranking methodology (community found the install-count leaderboard misleading), skill descriptions and copy-install buttons in the leaderboard listing itself, hands-on corroboration of `skills find` search, a catalog REST API.
